players.product: Ceramic housings and aluminium nitride ceramic substrates for optical communication modules

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): AI-driven compute demand has created explosive demand for optical modules; demand for ceramic housings and substrates, key optical-module packaging materials, is growing fast, with aluminium nitride thin-film substrates for low-cost non-hermetic packaging in short supply; orders for optical-module ceramic housings and ceramic substrates rose sharply and capacity utilization stays high.

Management (IR record): profit grew more slowly than revenue in H1 2026 because the fast-growing electronic ceramics products carry slightly lower gross margins than other segments, and rising gold and non-ferrous metal prices put cost pressure on ceramic housings.
Management (IR record), on the H2 2026 margin outlook: orders are full, capacity utilization has stayed high and scale effects will show further.

Management (IR record): its new high-precision electronic ceramic production line expansion covers aluminium nitride thin- and thick-film substrates, electronic ceramic housings for communication devices and precision ceramic parts; the products have passed verification at several large domestic customers and are supplied in volume; it says its ceramic housing performance is comparable to international large companies' products.

Management (IR record): subsidiary Guolian Wanzhong upgraded its 6-inch SiC line to 8-inch, completed fifth-generation planar-gate SiC MOSFET process development, and has delivered several 8-inch automotive chips to leading automakers for trial validation; its SiC high-voltage power module line is through.

Management (IR record): it acquired 100% of Xiongan Taixin, whose terahertz chips serve test and measurement, high-speed communication and body security screening; Xiongan Taixin's H1 2026 revenue was RMB 6,660.76 ten-thousand and net profit RMB 1,817.75 ten-thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 6,660.76 ten-thousand; net profit RMB 1,817.75 ten-thousand (H1 2026)

Sinopack.why: Makes the ceramic housings and AlN substrates used to package optical modules; orders for optical-module ceramic housings and substrates rise with AI optical module demand.
Sinopack.evidence: Sinopack IR activity record: 2026-09-17 (09-17-2026): as key optical-module packaging materials, ceramic housings and substrates see fast-growing demand; orders for optical-module ceramic housings and ceramic substrates rose sharply.
